description: Doctrine ORM provider for the auditor PHP audit log library: tracks inserts, updates, removals and many-to-many changes in audit tables and queries them with a reader.
rules: Symfony applications install damienharper/auditor-bundle, which requires and configures this provider.
Only changes flushed through the Doctrine ORM unit of work are audited: DQL updates and raw SQL statements are not.
In auditor 4.x the same DH\Auditor\Provider\Doctrine namespace was bundled in damienharper/auditor; since 5.0 it comes from this package.
